en.q: Each side of a metallic cube of mass 5.580 kg is measured to be 9.0 cm. Keeping the significant figures in view, the density of the material of the cube can be best expressed as X × 10<sup>3</sup> kg m<sup>−3</sup>, where the value of X is :

review.keyCheck: DIFFERS from Answer key Code 13, NEET 2026 (4); ours: 2
review.keySource: Answer key Codes 11–14 (neet-sources/neet-papers/2026/answer-key-codes-11-14.pdf), Code 13 (content/keys/neet-official-keys.json); text from the Code 13 question booklet scan (neet-sources/neet-papers/2026/question-booklet-code-13-with-answers.pdf; read from page images)
review.note: Density = 5.580 kg / (0.090 m)3 = 7.654 × 103 kg m−3. The side (9.0 cm) has two significant figures, so the result rounds to 7.7 (option 2). The Code 13 key gives option (4), 7.6, which is truncated rather than rounded.
